requires: An M-VAVE FM-1 running stock V15 or official fm1_open firmware. If it runs stock V15, this page installs official Open first
Chrome or Edge on a computer, with MIDI and SysEx allowed
Anything you want to keep backed up. On official Open, M-VAVE's workbench backs up projects, samples and voices. Stock V15 has no project library for it to read

notes: Firmware 0.8.2 fixes the reset loop at the start-up screen that stopped the first test on a real FM-1: an audio buffer was misaligned, which the FM-1's chip treats as a fatal fault.

The start-up screen carries the logo. Copy a page and paste it to any other with SEQ+OCT− and SEQ+OCT+, as one undo. SYSTEM is down to version, build, CPU and faults. 64 steps on four pages, the keyboard as the pattern on SEQ, conditions, projects saved in user Flash.
Tested on the host and in the FM-1 emulator, now also under the chip's alignment rule. 0.8.2 itself has not run on a device, and the fix is not yet confirmed on one.
If 0.8.1 left your FM-1 restarting: power on holding HOME until SAFE MODE shows, then connect the installer. This should keep the engine off long enough to update; it has not been tried on a device.
